objects.name: Meta Says 20,000 Instagram Accounts Hacked via AI Tool Abuse
objects.description: The social media giant has informed authorities about the impact of the recent attack involving an account recovery support tool. The post Meta Says 20,000 Instagram Accounts Hacked via AI Tool Abuse appeared first on SecurityWeek .
